node.title: L1 polynomial-led interior cells are deeper-Q curves
node.statement: Let H subset B, m>k, w=m-k, and 1<=e<=k. For a base-field polynomial-led word U monic of degree m+e, every exact level-m codeword has U-P=L_T R_s, where the first e locator coefficients s determine the monic degree-e cofactor triangularly and the next w locator coefficients recursively. Hence Z_m(U) is exactly the disjoint sum over s in B^e of depth-(w+e) locator-prefix fibers along an injective curve theta_z, retaining gcd(R_s,Omega/L_T)=1 in each slice. Ambient means cancel the B^e slice count, but a discrete max-fiber bound leaves a B^e additive term. Nonconstant minimal vectors and e>k remain open.
